label: Chaos
description: Unpredictable, erratic, glitchy patterns that keep you guessing. Sudden shifts, irregular rhythms, and chaotic energy that defies expectation.

patterns.name: Glitch Burst
patterns.description: Sudden stuttering bursts across every channel, glitching in and out of silence.

patterns.name: Manic Spiral
patterns.description: A spiral of swings that widen and tighten with no clear peak, then collapse and begin again.

patterns.name: Jerky Rhythm
patterns.description: Staccato pulses that jump unpredictably in level and timing, with stuttered doubles.

patterns.name: Silence Ambush
patterns.description: Long quiet periods broken by sudden brutal attacks.

patterns.name: Random Walk
patterns.description: Wandering intensity that never settles into a pattern, a long drunken walk.

patterns.name: Thrust Chaos
patterns.description: Irregular thrusting with unpredictable vibration bursts.

patterns.name: Digital Stutter
patterns.description: Glitchy stuttering like a corrupted audio file, skipping, repeating and dropping out.

patterns.name: Pump Frenzy
patterns.description: Air pump squeezing and releasing in erratic, uneven swells.

patterns.name: Stroke Madness
patterns.description: Wild thrusting that swerves unpredictably, surging and sagging across the whole pass.

patterns.name: Squeeze Chaos
patterns.description: Unpredictable squeezes with matching vibration.

patterns.name: Dual Chaos
patterns.description: Both motors performing separate chaotic dances that cross, collide and trade places.

patterns.name: Circling Frenzy
patterns.description: Chaotic circling that never settles into a rhythm.

patterns.name: Sudden Shifts
patterns.description: Jarring transitions between extremes with no warning.

patterns.name: Irregular Waves
patterns.description: Wave patterns with inconsistent periods and amplitudes.

patterns.name: Rotate Whirl
patterns.description: Random rotation directions and speeds creating chaos.

patterns.name: Spike and Valley
patterns.description: Extreme peaks followed by deep valleys at random intervals.

patterns.name: Broken Beat
patterns.description: A beat that keeps trying to establish itself but keeps breaking.

patterns.name: Multi-Channel Chaos
patterns.description: Every channel doing something different and unpredictable, in long restless phrases.

patterns.name: Chaotic Crescendo
patterns.description: A climb to a peak that keeps getting cut off, each attempt closer, ending in a ragged collapse.

patterns.name: Quiet Chaos
patterns.description: Subtle chaotic vibrations that stay at low levels.

patterns.name: Pulsing Madness
patterns.description: Pulses that vary wildly in timing and intensity, with long silences and sudden flurries.

patterns.name: Silence Storm
patterns.description: Storm of activity broken by unpredictable silences.
